content:
Brickmasons and Blockmasons


About the Role
Lay and bind building materials, such as brick, structural tile, concrete block, cinder block, glass block, and terra-cotta block, with mortar and other substances, to construct or repair walls, partitions, arches, sewers, and other structures.
What You'll Do
Measure distance from reference points and mark guidelines to lay out work, using plumb bobs and levels.
Construct corners by fastening corner poles and filling in between using a line guide.
Apply and smooth mortar or other mixture over work surface.
Calculate angles and courses and determine vertical and horizontal alignment.
Break or cut bricks, tiles, or blocks to size, using trowel edge, hammer, or power saw.
Interpret blueprints and drawings to determine specifications and calculate materials required.
Remove excess mortar and finish joints with jointing tools for a uniform appearance.
Examine brickwork or structure to determine need for repair.


Tools & Technology
Estimating software (Project management software)
Microsoft Excel (Spreadsheet software)
Education & Experience
Education: High school diploma or equivalent
On-the-Job Training: 2 to 4 years
Related Work Experience: 2 years to 4 years
Work Environment
Outdoors, exposed to all weather conditions
Wear safety equipment
Exposed to hazardous equipment and noise
